trailhead.label: Village square by the school and church in Tabland, Citybus 264 (official start)

cautions: This package has not yet had a dated field review; check signs on the ground.
Heat risk is high on this walk: start early and carry extra water.
The first and last kilometre are on tarmac roads open to cars, including the Tabland road back to the village.
A rougher stretch of path and track near km 2.4–2.7.
Rock outcrops at some of the viewpoints.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Local lead rules and temporary closures can change.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
